integrity: The generalized-prior information formulas are derived analytically from the source's click probabilities and domination inequalities. A standalone standard-library verifier supplies rigorous rational logarithm intervals for the numerical threshold; finite computation supports only the displayed transcendental comparison, not the structural proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is a lower bound for the explicit encoding and fixed joint measurement of arXiv:2609.10520v1; it does not determine the exact private capacity.
The rational parameters are a reproducible improving point and are not claimed globally optimal even within the two-parameter prior/dilution family.
The proof uses the environmental operator-order constants 205/9 and 4 established in the source and does not improve those constants.
title: A stronger explicit private-rate certificate for zero-capacity superactivation
